# Embedded emissions cannot be computed: country of production is missing

## Input check

| Required input | Provided | Status |
|---|---|---|
| (a) CN code in table | 7201 (Pig iron) | ✅ Present and listed |
| (b) Country of production | *blank* | ❌ **Missing** |
| (c) Quantity (t) | 1,500 | ✅ Present |

## Why I stopped

Under the ruleset, the default SEE is selected jointly by **CN code and country**. CN 7201 has a different value for each listed country (Türkiye, China, India). Without the country, I cannot select an SEE. The ruleset says not to estimate when a required input is missing, so I have not assumed a country or reported a figure.

The production route ("blast furnace") and installation ("Works 2") do not affect the default SEE in this table, so they cannot substitute for the country.

## What's needed

Please provide the **country of production** for the pig iron from Works 2. If it is Türkiye, China, or India, the calculation is:

> Embedded emissions = SEE (CN 7201, country) × 1,500 t, rounded half-up to 2 decimal places.

If the country is not one of these three, CN 7201 has no default value in this table, and the emissions still cannot be computed under this ruleset.
